items.title: Regular systems of parameters in power series rings over a field and over a Cohen ring
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records the four standard consequences of choosing a regular system of parameters in a power series ring, once over a field and once over a Cohen ring: any two such systems present the ring as a power series ring on the system, any part of a system can be completed and the quotient is again a power series ring over the same base, and the same two statements hold for the system starting with p over a Cohen ring (statement lines 9736-9751). The proof is a 13-line argument (proof lines 9754-9766) which for (1) compares the two complete local rings by the surjections on the quotients by powers of the maximal ideal, for (2) extends the given partial system to a full one and reduces to (1), and then declares for (3) and (4) that the proofs are exactly the same. The decisive step is the passage from the identification of all the infinitesimal quotients to an isomorphism of complete rings, which is the completeness hypothesis doing real work; the author states it in one sentence and leaves the rest of the (3) and (4) cases by symmetry.
